LanguageData.LR_PocLimits: Single-map rail with 1/2/4-platform stations and freight warehouses, 2–16 stop shuttle or loop routes, line colors and a Rail management tab. One train per route; routes reserve disjoint track cells. Four seats, twelve cargo stack slots. Platform dwell can be manual or automatic.
LanguageData.LR_StationInfo: Stations on map: {0}. Connect tracks, then create an operating route.
LanguageData.LR_TravelTo: Travel to station ({0}, {1}); use rail when beneficial
LanguageData.LR_TravelToNamed: Travel to {0}; use rail when beneficial
LanguageData.LR_RenameStation: Name this station to identify destinations.
LanguageData.LR_PreferRail: Prefer rail for long journeys, accepting reasonable waits
LanguageData.LR_CreateServiceDesc: Configure station/platform stops, shuttle or loop, route color and per-platform dwell.
LanguageData.LR_InvalidEndpoints: Two different player stations on this map are required
LanguageData.LR_NetworkInUse: This connected rail network already has a route
LanguageData.LR_NetworkConflict: Networks merged: another shuttle has operating priority
LanguageData.LR_TrainOffRoute: Train is off the route: adjust tracks or recreate service
LanguageData.LR_NoService: No operating route assigned. Passengers do not summon trains.
LanguageData.LR_ToggleServiceDesc: Pausing releases passengers and retains the train. Resume to continue the shuttle.
LanguageData.LR_SelectTrainDesc: Jump to this route's existing train.
LanguageData.LR_RemoveServiceDesc: Resume passengers' original jobs and remove this service and train. Keep stations and tracks.
LanguageData.LR_ReplaceTrainDesc: When the train is missing, allocate a free replacement at the starting terminal.
LanguageData.LR_RouteEditorHelp: Add ordered platform stops. Loops close back to the first stop; shuttles reverse at their ends.
LanguageData.LR_InvalidRoute: Choose 2–16 distinct connected platforms. Shuttles may retrace their rails; loops require a closed path without repeated cells.
LanguageData.LR_EditRouteDesc: Change ordered stops and station dwell. Release current passengers when applying.
LanguageData.LR_FreightDestinationDesc: Choose an exact destination platform on the same route. Automatic trains collect warehouse inventory using this default when no matching dispatch rule applies. At other stations, colonists manually deposit cargo using the right-click menu.
LanguageData.LR_SetDwellDesc: Enter game seconds or enable bounded automatic boarding/loading dwell for each platform.
LanguageData.LR_RemoveConfirm: Remove {0} and its train? Passengers resume work; freight is placed back on the map. Tracks and stations remain.
LanguageData.LR_NoRoutes: No routes match. Create a route after connecting station platforms.
LanguageData.LR_AutoDwell: Automatically manage dwell at this platform
LanguageData.LR_LoopNotClosed: This loop has no valid closing track.
LanguageData.LR_MinAboveMax: Minimum dwell cannot exceed maximum dwell.
LanguageData.LR_ManagerHelp: Manage routes and individual platform connections in the Rail tab.
LanguageData.LR_ManagerNetworkRule: One train per route. Each track cell is reserved for one route.
LanguageData.LR_ShowAllRoutes: Show all route colors on map
LanguageData.LR_EditorNetworkHelp: Choose the exact platforms. Shuttles may retrace their own rails; loops must close. Different routes cannot share track cells.
LanguageData.LR_PlatformHelp: Platform numbering rotates with the station; by default south to north. Tracks remain independent and connect outside the building.
LanguageData.LR_AutoDwellHelp: Wait at least the minimum, with boarding/loading time and a 1-second quiet period. Hold for nearby approaching passengers or loaders until the maximum. Full trains do not wait indefinitely.
LanguageData.LR_DisconnectedPlatforms: No connecting path: {0} → {1}. Check real rail connections and stop order. Shuttles may retrace their rails; loops require a closed path without repeated cells.
LanguageData.LR_TrainAhead: Waiting for another train to clear the cell
LanguageData.LR_InvalidSeconds: Enter valid game seconds: manual/max 0.5–120, minimum 0.5–30.
LanguageData.LR_NoMap: Open a colony map to manage rail.
LanguageData.LR_OverlapRoute: Track already reserved by {0}. Choose another platform or track.
LanguageData.LR_DoorWaiting: Waiting for rail door to open / permission
LanguageData.LR_RailDoorHelp: Automatic metal door with built-in track. Keep the portal straight. Trains open it in advance; no power required. Durability and speed follow the chosen metal.
LanguageData.LR_DoorStraight: Rail door at {0} requires straight entry and exit. Move the curve outside the doorway.
LanguageData.LR_WarehouseHelp: Colonists haul stock into native storage rows. Automatic trains deliver it using the default destination or the first matching dispatch rule. Ordinary trains require manually deposited cargo. Full or rejecting targets keep cargo aboard and retry next visit. Configure accepted items in Storage.
LanguageData.LR_ExportReceived: Allow onward dispatch of received cargo (check for cyclic rules)
LanguageData.LR_NoWarehouseRoutes: Create a route through this warehouse first; each destination must be another stop on that route.
LanguageData.LR_UnloadBlockedInfo: {0}: unloading at {1} is blocked or rejected. Remaining cargo stays aboard; the train continues and retries next visit.
LanguageData.LR_PickerHelp: Pan and zoom the map; click a rail row inside a station. Numbers match the list. Locate pans to a platform. Gray means selected or disconnected; yellow highlights the current platform. Right-click or Back cancels picking.
LanguageData.LR_CargoSlotsHelp: Each slot holds one native item stack. Hover to see its destination platform. Blocked cargo stays aboard until a later visit.
LanguageData.LR_DispatchPriority: Automatic storage: dispatch depot (Preferred; delivered cargo treated as Low)
LanguageData.LR_AutoStoragePriorityHelp: Without a destination or dispatch rules, use Low for receiving; a default destination or enabled rules uses Preferred for gathering. Delivered cargo is not reclaimed by automatic depots and can leave mixed depots for normal storage. Disable this option or change native priority to customize.
LanguageData.LR_TrainKindsHelp: Ordinary trains carry passengers and manually deposited cargo. Automatic trains additionally collect warehouse inventory without riders. Set a warehouse default destination or dispatch rules; delivered cargo is protected against return loops. Existing trains and cargo survive type changes.
LanguageData.LR_ReasonDisabled: Automatic passenger travel is disabled in mod settings.
LanguageData.LR_ReasonDrafted: Drafted colonists use their issued movement orders. Undraft to enable automatic commuting.
LanguageData.LR_ReasonJob: This pawn or current job is not eligible for safe automatic commuting. Supported travel includes hauling, mining, planting, research, cleaning and ordinary movement.
LanguageData.LR_ReasonAssigned: This colonist already has an approaching, waiting or riding assignment.
LanguageData.LR_ReasonNotMoving: There is no active walking path in a supported travel step. Recheck while the colonist is walking to the distant job.
LanguageData.LR_ReasonShort: The current remaining journey is shorter than the minimum distance in mod settings.
LanguageData.LR_ReasonNoStations: No accessible station was found near the pawn or destination within the configured radius. Move a station closer or increase the access radius.
LanguageData.LR_ReasonNoService: Nearby stations lack an operating passenger-capable route. Check route creation, pause state and train availability. Freight-only trains do not accept passengers.
LanguageData.LR_ReasonAccess: A safe walking connection to a served platform could not be found within the search budget. Check doors, walls, allowed areas and hazards.
LanguageData.LR_ReasonUnsafe: The rail journey crosses a forbidden, dangerous or inaccessible cell.
LanguageData.LR_ReasonCost: Walking currently wins: access walking or waiting exceeds the selected preference limits. Rail preference allows up to 80% access/egress walking and at most twice the direct walking estimate.
LanguageData.LR_ReasonSelected: A suitable train route is available. This diagnostic does not issue orders; normal movement will schedule boarding automatically.
LanguageData.LR_DecisionContext: Job: {0} | access radius: {1} | stations near start / end: {2} / {3}
LanguageData.LR_DecisionCosts: Estimated game seconds — direct walk: {0}; walk to station: {1}; walk after arrival: {2}; train travel: {3}; waiting: {4}.
LanguageData.LR_DecisionHelp: Select a colonist while walking and re-evaluate to inspect station access, operating routes and travel costs. This snapshot never changes their work or forces boarding. Enable Rail preference in mod settings for long-distance commuting.
LanguageData.LR_DefaultInventoryHelp: Automatic trains collect inventory even without riders and deliver it here. Enabled, matching dispatch rules take priority; unmatched stock uses this default destination. Received cargo is not re-exported by default. Ordinary trains require manually deposited cargo.
LanguageData.LR_AutomaticRequired: This dispatch rule requires an automatic train. Change the type in the route editor.
